name: Teddy Bundy
source:
"You don't make sense very often. That's probably okay, but maybe you should talk less."

Teddy is the fun and free-spirited type. She can be a smartass, but more often comes across as the opposite. She's just looking for a good time! Or not, she doesn't really care either way.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sugarslip/serial-lover/]Kickstarter[/url]]
